children: APAC Realty is set to benefit from a projected increase in Singapore residential transaction volumes in 4Q, says RHB Research's Vijay Natarajan in a note, citing a healthy project launch pipeline with visibility through mid-2028. This should drive the Singapore real-estate services company's earnings, the analyst says. He continues to like APAC Realty for its asset-light model and net cash position. Its proposed acquisition of a remaining stake in subsidiary ERA Indonesia should improve its operational efficiency and reduce listing costs, he adds. RHB retains its buy rating and its target price of 74 Singapore cents on APAC Realty. Shares drop 0.9% to S$0.575. (megan.cheah@wsj.com)
